datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across South Sudan in 2017. Geographic boundaries and classification phases were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing food insecurity scenarios at three time points (February, June, October 2017). The dataset represents post-assessment impact classifications of food insecurity conditions.
